GoGloby
GoGloby is an Applied AI Engineering partner turning engineering into AI-native production: every AI dollar visible, every feature shipped faster.
What is Applied AI Engineering?
Applied AI Engineering is the discipline of productionizing and operating AI inside real systems. An Applied AI Engineer practices it: a senior engineer who uses Claude Code, Cursor and agent frameworks to architect, build and ship software, measured against the team’s own baseline rather than against a generic comparison. They don't just use AI; they govern it. They write specifications before code, manage AI context deliberately, and take full ownership of every AI-assisted output. Applied AI Engineers sit at the intersection of deep software engineering and Agentic SDLC mastery
How is GoGloby's 4-Stage Applied AI Vetting Process different from a general vetting process?
A general vetting process screens for years of experience, GitHub activity, and algorithm questions. GoGloby's 4-stage funnel tests what actually matters in production: Can they specify before they code? Can they navigate a real codebase with AI without losing control? Can they architect multi-agent systems under real constraints? Can they govern AI failures in front of stakeholders? Each stage eliminates 60–70% of remaining candidates. Only 4% pass. By the time a candidate reaches your shortlist, they've already proved they can do the job — not just interview for it.
Why Is It So Hard to hire an Applied AI Engineer?
Because the market is flooded with developers who can prompt an AI tool but can't architect, govern, or ship with it at production scale. Standard job boards and general tech recruiters have no framework to tell the difference. Most hiring managers spend months interviewing candidates who look right on paper and fail on real engineering tasks. The signal problem isn't supply — it's that the vetting infrastructure to identify genuine Applied AI mastery simply doesn't exist in most hiring processes.
Can GoGloby Recruit a Full Applied AI Engineering Team?
Yes. GoGloby recruits individual Applied AI Engineers and complete engineering functions. Every candidate runs the same 4-stage assessment regardless of team size, so every name on your shortlist has cleared the same bar.
What Happens If the Applied AI Engineer Leaves After the 120-day Window?
The 120-day replacement guarantee covers the highest-risk period of a new hire. After that window, GoGloby offers preferred re-engagement terms. If you need to backfill the role, you move to the front of the queue at a reduced fee.
Does GoGloby Recruit For Remote, Hybrid, or On-Site Applied AI Engineers?
GoGloby recruits across all work models — remote, hybrid, and on-site. Our talent network spans 5+ US-timezone countries, so whether your team operates fully distributed or requires in-office presence, we source candidates who match both your technical bar and your working model. Every shortlist is filtered to your specific requirements before it reaches you.
Should We Hire Directly or Forward-Deploy an Architect?
Direct hire suits a permanent role you will manage and retain long term. The forward-deployed model puts Claude Certified Architects, AI Solutions Architects and Applied AI Engineers inside your team, and suits a mandate on a clock where you need features shipping at AI speed within weeks. GoGloby runs both. See our AI Staff Augmentation page.
What does the Benchmark include?
Every engagement starts with the Benchmark: a fixed fee for one month, with the AI Intelligence Layer deployed inside your VPC and your baseline delivered at the end of it. The fee is credited in full toward your first month of delivery. If you stop there, you keep the baseline.

zones.label: How we work: The 4% Vetting Pass Rate
zones.text:
Assessment Methodology
The 4% Vetting Pass Rate
We run a 4-stage technical assessment to validate real Agentic SDLC mastery. By the time you interview someone, the hard vetting is already done.
Can They Specify?
Before writing a single line of code, candidates must produce a strict, machine-readable architectural spec. Most can’t. This stage alone eliminates ~70% of candidates.
Can They Navigate?
We drop them into a 100K+ line codebase with Claude Code or Cursor and watch how they work. Context discipline and output validation separate real engineers from prompt jockeys.
Can They Architect?
Candidates design multi-agent systems, evaluate RAG trade-offs, and manage token economics under real constraints. No theory. Production-grade thinking only.
Can They Govern?
Their agent hallucinates in production. Walk us through the first 60 minutes. Only engineers who can own outcomes — not just output — make it through.

zones.label: How it works: Applied AI Engineering Hiring Process
zones.text:
Applied AI Engineering Hiring Process
From brief to hired — without a 6-month hiring cycle.
1
Requirements Deep Dive
We map your stack, team structure, technical environment, and engineering bar. The brief drives the search — precision here eliminates bad fits before sourcing begins.
2
Targeted Sourcing
We activate GoGloby’s network of Applied AI Engineers across 5+ US-timezone countries. No job board blasting. Targeted outreach to pre-qualified talent only.
3
4-Stage Vetting Funnel
Every candidate runs Specify → Navigate → Architect → Govern. Each stage eliminates 60–70% of remaining applicants. Only the top 4% make it through.
4
You Interview. You Decide.
You meet only pre-vetted candidates. No wasted interview loops. No paper tigers. You make the final call.
5
Offer Support & Close
We provide current AI market compensation benchmarks so you go in with the right number — and close the offer instead of losing at the final step.

By the time a candidate reaches your shortlist, they’ve already proved they can do the job — not just interview for it.
Why Is It So Hard to hire an Applied AI Engineer?

Because the market is flooded with developers who can prompt an AI tool but can’t architect, govern, or ship with it at production scale. Standard job boards and general tech recruiters have no framework to tell the difference. Most hiring managers spend months interviewing candidates who look right on paper and fail on real engineering tasks. The signal problem isn’t supply — it’s that the vetting infrastructure to identify genuine Applied AI mastery simply doesn’t exist in most hiring processes.
Can GoGloby Recruit a Full Applied AI Engineering Team?

Yes. GoGloby recruits individual Applied AI Engineers and complete engineering functions. Every candidate runs the same 4-stage assessment regardless of team size, so every name on your shortlist has cleared the same bar.
What Happens If the Applied AI Engineer Leaves After the 120-day Window?

The 120-day replacement guarantee covers the highest-risk period of a new hire. After that window, GoGloby offers preferred re-engagement terms. If you need to backfill the role, you move to the front of the queue at a reduced fee.
Does GoGloby Recruit For Remote, Hybrid, or On-Site Applied AI Engineers?

GoGloby recruits across all work models — remote, hybrid, and on-site. Our talent network spans 5+ US-timezone countries, so whether your team operates fully distributed or requires in-office presence, we source candidates who match both your technical bar and your working model. Every shortlist is filtered to your specific requirements before it reaches you.
Should We Hire Directly or Forward-Deploy an Architect?

Direct hire suits a permanent role you will manage and retain long term. The forward-deployed model puts Claude Certified Architects, AI Solutions Architects and Applied AI Engineers inside your team, and suits a mandate on a clock where you need features shipping at AI speed within weeks. GoGloby runs both. See our AI Staff Augmentation page.

Every engagement starts with the Benchmark: a fixed fee for one month, with the AI Intelligence Layer deployed inside your VPC and your baseline delivered at the end of it. The fee is credited in full toward your first month of delivery. If you stop there, you keep the baseline.
